name: graphify-context
description: Standing Codex context layer for Graphify-backed repository maps.

interface.shortDescription: Read Graphify maps before broad repo work.
interface.longDescription: A local-only Codex plugin that keeps Graphify as the first-pass context layer for architecture questions, cross-module reasoning, and multi-file edits while preserving local files as the source of truth.
defaultPrompt: Use Graphify context before explaining this repo.
Query Graphify before this multi-file edit.
